# Terminal Blockers

- AUTHORITY_CONFLICT: a requirement needs public ABI, wire/schema, a new semantic registry, or another unapproved authority change.
- MISSING_REQUIRED_INPUT: current authority, source identity, MSE case, test IDs, build environment or evidence binding is missing/mismatched.
- TASK_PACKAGE_DEFECT: required source owner/test path is outside allowlist or a required oracle is not frozen.
- ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKER: Windows/native or applicable actual Chrome/WASM environment cannot run.
- FROZEN_VERIFICATION_FAILURE: any MSE case or inherited regression fails, skips or fails exact-ID discovery.
- NEW_HIGH_IMPACT_FAILURE_MODE: partial canonical mutation, incorrect subset, stale target commit, undo/redo divergence, deadlock or inconsistent Scene/Document state.
- EXECUTION_DIVERGENCE: branch/cursor/anchor/locks differ from package.
- BLOCKED_KNOWN_HIGH_IMPACT_OOM_HANG: separate overall D07/release blocker remains; this package cannot close it.
